episode_summaries.notes: Series launch (EP1) for growtopia dual-style -- standard base format (2D pixel-art left, generic photorealistic right, no actor counterparts), reusing the game's existing canonical NPC reference sprites as the LEFT chain-ref (no new pixel-ref generation cost). User explicitly requested static standing idle poses only -- no walking/traversal -- to sidestep the game's known Kling I2V 'Minecraft morph' risk (see growtopia.md); camera kept to gentle push-in/near-locked only, no pull-backs or orbits. generate_audio:false on all 4 clips (bg-music.mp3 covers audio, avoids unwanted baked-in score). No YouTube channel mapped yet for this game -- deliverable is Supabase-only; upload scheduling deferred, will add YT fields to this entry once the user schedules a publish date.

First run under the dual-style-v3 contract (production_contract/comparison_mode source-vs-live-action, mandatory synchronized walking-approach + front dolly-back on every clip -- supersedes EP1's static-idle convention, which predates v3). RIGHT side stays a generic non-celebrity photorealistic person per this bible's established EP1 convention (user did not request actor casting). Mandatory user-requested pop-up promo CTA banner (existing branding/popup.png asset) added to scene 3 (climax) only. Animator hit a self-inflicted expect.min_width/min_height validation defect on scene 1 (too strict for Kling v3 Standard's real 716x1284 9:16 output) that discarded one completed paid generation ($0.63 sunk) before a corrected retry succeeded -- flagging so future runs default expect to ~600x1000 for this route. No YouTube channel mapped yet for growtopia -- Supabase-only deliverable.

style_tags: Dual-style split-frame format: LEFT side is the Growtopia in-game render — 2D pixel-art sprite, blocky humanoid, retro flat side-view design, thick clean black outlines, bright saturated candy colors, no 3D rendering (unchanged from the existing canonical reference sprite). RIGHT side is the photorealistic twin — a generic real-world person (not a celebrity look-alike), real skin textures, natural fabric/material textures, cinematic lighting, no cel-shading, no pixelation — wearing the identical costume/props/colors described in characters[]. Both figures share one continuous environment, no split panel. Note: EP1 used a static idle pose per an explicit one-off user request; motion (idle vs. walking-approach) is governed exclusively by rules/formats/dual-style.md's production_contract, not by this style_tags field — since EP2/EP3 (dual-style-v3), every clip is a mandatory synchronized walking-approach + front dolly-back.
